proof:
Conventions: ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) = Eucl P with norm |·|; Hⁿ = μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure, = μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)); on ℝⁿ, Hⁿ = Lⁿ = volume (`EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume`). B̄_ρ(y) = closedBall y ρ. η_{y,λ}(x) = λ⁻¹(x − y) is `Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y λ`. ∫_A f dHⁿ is the Bochner set integral (0 when f is not integrable on A); ∫⁻ is the [0,∞]-valued lintegral. 'T is the approximate tangent space of S at y' means `Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y T` (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4): finrank T = n and ∫_{η_{y,λ}(S)} φ dHⁿ → ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+ for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ). `HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T` (Def. 1.7) means finrank T = n and ∫_{η_{y,λ}(M)} φ(z) θ(y + λz) dHⁿ(z) → θ(y) ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+ for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ).

This is step 4 of the parent proof (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1): for x ∈ M_j off the null set where Θⁿ(θHⁿ⌞(M∖M_j), x) ≠ 0, T_x M_j exists ⇒ T_x M exists w.r.t. θ and equals T_x M_j). It uses the sibling results
 (BLOWUP) for λ > 0, any S and any g: ∫_{η_{y,λ}(S)} g dHⁿ = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_S g(η_{y,λ}(x)) dHⁿ(x);
 (DENSITY-BOUND) if T is the approximate tangent space of S at y and Hⁿ(S ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ for some r > 0, then there is K₀ ∈ ℝ≥0 with Hⁿ(S ∩ B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ K₀ · ofReal(ρⁿ) for all sufficiently small ρ > 0.
Let μ := μHE[n] on ℝ^Q.

1. (Dimension.) finrank T = n is part of the hypothesis that T is the approximate tangent space of C at y.

2. (Set-up.) Fix φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ); choose R > 0 with tsupport φ ⊆ B̄_R(0) and put A := sup|φ|. Fix r > 0 as in the hypothesis. By (DENSITY-BOUND) with S := C there are K₀ ∈ ℝ≥0 and ρ₀ > 0 with μ(C ∩ B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ K₀ ρⁿ for 0 < ρ < ρ₀.

3. (Change of variables.) Let λ > 0 with λR < min(r, ρ₀), and put η := η_{y,λ}, B := B̄_{λR}(y). By (BLOWUP) with g(z) := φ(z) θ(y + λz):
 W(λ) := ∫_{η(M)} φ(z) θ(y + λz) dHⁿ(z) = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_M φ(η(x)) θ(y + λη(x)) dμ(x) = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_M φ(η(x)) θ(x) dμ(x),
 since y + λ · λ⁻¹(x − y) = x.

4. (Decomposition.) As in the unweighted case, φ∘η vanishes outside B (φ(η(x)) ≠ 0 ⇒ |x − y| ≤ λR), so ∫_M (φ∘η)θ dμ = ∫_{M∩B} (φ∘η)θ dμ. θ is μ-integrable on M ∩ B ⊆ M ∩ B̄_r(y) and φ∘η is continuous and bounded, so (φ∘η)θ is integrable on M ∩ B. Since C ⊆ M, M ∩ B is the disjoint union of the null-measurable sets C ∩ B and (M ∖ C) ∩ B; μ(C ∩ B) ≤ μ(C ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞, so φ∘η and the constant θ(y) are integrable on C ∩ B. Hence W(λ) = I₁ + I₂ + I₃ with
 I₁ := θ(y) (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_{C∩B} φ∘η dμ,  I₂ := (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_{C∩B} (φ∘η)(θ − θ(y)) dμ,  I₃ := (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_{(M∖C)∩B} (φ∘η)θ dμ.

5. (Main term.) Since φ∘η = 0 off B, ∫_{C∩B} φ∘η dμ = ∫_C φ∘η dμ, and by (BLOWUP) (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_C φ∘η dμ = ∫_{η_{y,λ}(C)} φ dHⁿ. So I₁ = θ(y) ∫_{η_{y,λ}(C)} φ dHⁿ → θ(y) ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+, by the tangent hypothesis on C.

6. (Continuity error.) Let ε > 0. As θ|C is continuous at y, there is δ > 0 with |θ(x) − θ(y)| ≤ ε for all x ∈ C with |x − y| < δ. For λ with λR < min(r, ρ₀, δ), every x ∈ C ∩ B satisfies |x − y| ≤ λR < δ, so
 |I₂| ≤ (λⁿ)⁻¹ · A · ε · μ(C ∩ B̄_{λR}(y)).toReal ≤ (λⁿ)⁻¹ · A · ε · K₀ (λR)ⁿ = A ε K₀ Rⁿ.
 As ε > 0 is arbitrary, I₂ → 0 as λ → 0+.

7. (Remainder off C.) Since θ ≥ 0 on M ⊇ (M ∖ C) ∩ B and θ is integrable there, ∫_{(M∖C)∩B} θ dμ = (∫⁻_{(M∖C)∩B} ofReal(θ) dμ).toReal, and
 |I₃| ≤ (λⁿ)⁻¹ A ∫_{(M∖C)∩B} θ dμ = A Rⁿ · [ (∫⁻_{(M∖C) ∩ B̄_{λR}(y)} ofReal(θ) dμ) / ofReal((λR)ⁿ) ].toReal.
 The map λ ↦ λR tends to 0 within (0, ∞) as λ → 0+, so by the density hypothesis the bracket tends to 0 in [0, ∞], and its toReal tends to 0. Hence I₃ → 0.

8. (Conclusion.) By steps 4–7, W(λ) = I₁ + I₂ + I₃ → θ(y) ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+, for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ). With finrank T = n (step 1) this is HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T. ∎
key_steps: finrank T = n is inherited from C; DENSITY-BOUND gives Hⁿ(C ∩ B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ K₀ρⁿ for small ρ.
BLOWUP with g(z) = φ(z)θ(y + λz) rewrites the weighted blow-up integral as λ^{−n} ∫_{M∩B̄_{λR}(y)} φ(η(x))θ(x) dHⁿ.
Split into I₁ = θ(y)·∫_{η(C)} φ → θ(y)∫_T φ, I₂ (continuity of θ|C at y times the bounded density ratio) → 0, and I₃ (θ-density of M∖C) → 0.
